svg.title: J4 Staff reply into the patient's chat

g.text: J4 Staff reply into the patient's chat
Priority: urgent, needs human, answered, closed;
and #staff-send. "Needs human" older than 2 h shows
"over 2 h". Call list: needs human, or a booking not
closed, oldest first. Unknown list: "not sure" questions.
Status after a reply: urgent and needs human
a new patient question raises a storage event that redraws /staff; it also redraws every 30 s unless #staff-reply has focus
